summary: Retire the former EKODI Work public subdomain completely, with no redirect, and make https://ekodi.kr/work the sole public EKODI Work entry while keeping the Work Worker as an internal service-binding execution boundary.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed that the former Work subdomain be completely removed rather than redirected, and approved conversion to the ekodi.kr/work user surface and dedicated ekodi.kr/work/admin management surface.
migrationPolicy: Verify https://ekodi.kr/work through the Shared Site WORK service binding, remove the Work Worker custom-domain declaration, replace all user-facing and operational references with apex paths, then detach the Cloudflare Worker custom domain and purge any A, AAAA, or CNAME record for the retired host. The retired hostname must not be registered as a compatibility redirect.
rollbackPlan: If apex Work verification fails before detachment, stop retirement and leave the current domain binding untouched while rolling back the application release. After successful detachment and DNS purge, restore only the last verified apex-path application artifact if needed; do not recreate the retired Work subdomain without a new explicit C3 approval.
